title: Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes
abstract: arXiv:2611.06879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The best classical optimizer for a continuous black-box problem depends on its budget and landscape. Existing routers decide from the dimension and budget, past improvement or features fitted to one benchmark, and few test an optimizer's implicit assumptions online. AMM (Adaptive Multi Mode) routes a known budget among quasi-Newton, trust-region, coordinate, multistart and evolution-strategy optimization engines with online probes of curvature, plateaus, separability, kinks, basins and fractal structure. Each probe has a default, a dimension-by-budget validity range and a cost charged to the budget. In its pre-registered development loop on bbob, 32 of 36 predictions held over the last 16 confirmations. AMM was then tested once on held-out bbob instances 101-110 (D=2-40, 10*D-1000*D) against up to seven competitors. translated_title: 自适应多模式：基于在线景观探测的优化器预算感知路由
translated_abstract: 对于连续黑盒优化问题，最佳的经典优化器取决于其可用预算和问题景观。现有的路由器仅依据维度与预算、过往改进情况或针对单一基准拟合的特征来做决策，很少有方法在线测试优化器的隐含假设。AMM（自适应多模式）通过在线探测曲率、平台、可分离性、折点、盆地和分形结构等特征，将已知预算分配到拟牛顿、信赖域、坐标法、多起点和演化策略等优化引擎之间。每个探测方法都有默认设置、基于维度与预算的有效范围，以及计入预算的成本。在其预注册的开发流程中，在bbob基准上，36个预测中有32个在最后16次验证中得到确认。随后，AMM在留出的bbob实例101-110（D=2-40，10*D至1000*D预算）上进行了单次测试，与最多七个竞争者对比。它在600个函数-维度-预算组合中的382个（236个单独领先，146个并列）拥有最高的目标份额，并通过描述性（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: AMM通过在线探测优化问题的景观特征（如曲率、可分离性等），将优化预算智能分配给拟牛顿、信赖域、演化策略等不同经典优化器，在bbob基准的600个函数-维度-预算组合中有382个取得最高目标份额。
en_tdlr: AMM routes a known optimization budget among classical optimizers via online landscape probes of curvature, separability, and other features, achieving the highest target share in 382 of 600 function-dimension-budget cells on the bbob benchmark against up to seven competitors.
